description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'HeaderEntryFilters' which provides factory methods to create various HeaderEntryFilter instances used for filtering header entries in a protocol adapter context. It includes methods for creating filters that handle external headers, internal Ditto acknowledgment headers, reading JSON array headers, and filtering for header existence and external definitions.

classes.name: HeaderEntryFilters
classes.description: A final utility class providing static factory methods to create HeaderEntryFilter objects for various filtering scenarios in protocol header management.

methods.name: toExternalHeadersFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter that filters out headers not to be written externally and discards internal Ditto acknowledgment headers if header definitions are provided.

methods.name: fromExternalHeadersFilter
methods.description: Creates a filter that filters out headers not to be read from external sources and reads JSON array headers.

methods.name: existsAsHeaderDefinition
methods.description: Creates a filter that passes only headers that are defined as HeaderDefinitions.

methods.name: existsAsHeaderDefinitionAndExternal
methods.description: Combines filters to pass only headers that exist as definitions and are meant to be written externally.
